items.name: Eswatini Nationals 2026

venue.name: Manzini Public Library
venue.address: Corner Sandlane and Nkose'luhlaza Streets, Manzini, Eswatini

items.information:
First official WCA competition in Eswatini.

The fastest competitor from Eswatini in 3x3 event will be crowned national champion of Eswatini.

Everyone can participate, but only people with Eswatini nationality can win prizes and honours.

Three spots in the 3x3 final will be reserved for participants with Eswatini nationality.

The competition is part of a tour around six countries in three weeks.
